objective: Beat the accuracy/latency Pareto frontier on CIFAR-10: maximize test top-1 accuracy subject to a HARD constraint of single-image CPU inference latency <= 1.0 ms (single core, int8 permitted), training budget <= 30 min on one consumer machine.

hard_constraints.name: cpu_latency_ms_per_image
hard_constraints.measurement: single core, batch=1, int8 allowed, median of 1000 runs

metric_spec.composite: accuracy is the score; any candidate violating a hard constraint scores 0 (dominated)

sota_reference: to be established by Sage (accuracy-under-1ms-CPU frontier, not unconstrained SOTA)
